title: Wiring an Inference Pool
description: Assemble an InferencePool and its endpoint picker by hand, then meet the three ways it can be running, healthy and completely useless: a permission it will not start without, a TLS instruction no Gateway API object can express, and a failureMode whose two values behave identically
